methods.name: MCP regression tools through call_tool_with_session: glmnet JSON, GLS rho, quantreg, OLS aliasing, diagnostics, HAC/DK, smoothers, step, NLS
methods.reference: glmnet::glmnet, glmnet::cv.glmnet, nlme::gls, quantreg::rq/summary.rq, lm, lmtest, sandwich, loess, supsmu, smooth.spline, step, nls (the R cases of each method)
quantities: glmnet coefficient path (lasso, ridge, binomial) and default path lambdas/df
GLS rho, coefficients, SEs, sigma, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC (REML, ML, fixed rho; CS within groups, AR(1))
quantreg coefficients and nid/iid/ker SEs at tau 0.25, 0.5, 0.75
aliased OLS rows
JB, BP, DW, condition number, bgtest F, RESET princomp, Wald F, Harvey-Collier
HAC Parzen SEs (lag 3 = kernHAC(bw = 4)), DK coefficients and SEs (vcovPL(lag = 2, adjust = FALSE))
loess fitted values, supsmu smooths, step criteria, nls estimates and SEs
methods.tolerance: glmnet coefficients 1e-3 absolute at MCP's thresh 1e-7 (an R port of p2a's coordinate descent lies at most 1.7e-4 from the exact minimiser on these fits), deviance ratios 1e-5 absolute, default path lambdas Tol::coef(150), df exact; GLS coefficients Tol::coef(n), SEs Tol::se(n), sigma, log-likelihood, AIC, BIC Tol::stat(n), rho 1e-6 relative; text at the printed precision (Tol::printed: half a unit of the last printed digit); loess Tol::coef(10) / Tol::coef(100), supsmu Tol::coef(100), step Tol::stat(n)

deviations.note: not R-pinned (REG-29, REG-30, Tier 4): the property test test_mcp_smooth_spline_criterion (unregistered) compares with the library and checks GCV and CV differ

methods.name: MCP discrete-choice tools: mlogit constants and reflevel, glm logit/probit, multinom, hurdle binary part, FEGLM gaussian, option parsing, seeds
methods.reference: mlogit::mlogit (tight MLE), stats::glm, nnet::multinom (tight MLE), pscl::hurdle binary part, fixest::feglm
quantities: mlogit coefficients and SEs with and without ASCs and with reflevel (asc_*_tight, noasc_*_tight, pier_*_tight), log-likelihood
logit coefficients and SEs (logit_coef, logit_se), probit coefficients and SEs (probit_coef_tight, probit_se_tight), aliased row, outcome domain, convergence line
multinom coefficients and SEs (two references, tight MLE)
hurdle binary-part coefficients (zero_coef) and SEs (zero_se_tight)
FEGLM gaussian coefficients
methods.tolerance: text at the printed precision (4 decimals, Tol::printed)

methods.name: MCP survival tools: Cox robust, clustered and Breslow fits; AFT distributions; competing-risks CIF
methods.reference: survival::coxph(robust, cluster, ties), survival::survreg(dist), survival::survfit multi-state (Aalen-Johansen)
quantities: Cox coefficients, model, robust and clustered SEs, robust score test
AFT coefficients, SEs, scale, log-likelihood
CIF point estimates of two event types
methods.tolerance: text at the printed precision (4 decimals; the robust score test 2)

methods.name: MCP panel tools: system GMM, unit-root lag selection, PVCM/PMG/pooled GLS, FE with absorbed regressors
methods.reference: plm::pgmm(transformation = 'ld'), plm::purtest(lags = 'AIC' | 'SIC'), plm::pvcm, plm::pmg, plm::pggls, plm::plm(model = 'within')
quantities: system GMM two-step and one-step coefficients and robust SEs, equation counts, Sargan
per-unit AIC/SIC lag summary
Swamy coefficients and SEs, MG and pooled FGLS coefficients
FE coefficients and SEs with a dropped regressor
methods.tolerance: text at the printed precision (4 decimals; lag means 2)

k-means WCSS and sizes, Moran's I
